name: ads-kit
description: Paid-ads engineer for small businesses: maps every lead path, proves click capture end to end, builds Google and Meta campaigns from an ad matrix, reviews results against CRM-qualified leads (not platform claims), keeps the creative library, and writes branded reports. It proposes every money change; a person or the standing limit in the marketing data tool acts. Works alone or as the AI CMO's ads engineer. Free and open source (MIT).
